youtube.baslik: Is a baby with no recordable ABR completely deaf? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In auditory neuropathy spectrum disorder (ANSD), neural ABR waves are absent, but this does not tell how much the baby hears; in these babies the ABR cannot be used to estimate thresholds. In the example case, click ABR showed no neural waves even at high intensity, while at eight months corrected age, minimum response levels with VRA were 45 to 55 dB HL. The real difficulty may lie more in discriminating speech than in thresholds; intervention rests on behavioral thresholds, cortical responses and functional observations.
